Manual next/previous · pagination · pause control · one primary CTA per slide

Fixed camera · stable lighting · one complete turn
Check blur, crop and angle continuity
GENERATED FRAME STRIP / EDIT ORDER + REJECT BAD FRAMES
Publish only after human visual review.
• 4–10 isolated stills are not enough for a true, accurate smooth 360° spin.
• Prefer one fixed-camera full-turn video or ordered 24 / 36 / 72 real frames.
• 36-frame image sequence is a spin viewer, not a geometry-based 3D model.
• Every SKU/color needs its own matching spin asset; no invented AI angles in live sales.
